svg.text: Data-line pull-up is the STM32 internal pull-up,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: enabled in firmware. Many modules also carry one.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If reads fail checksum, fit a 4.7 kΩ to 3V3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The AM2320 reports both chamber temperature and headspace

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: humidity over one data line, so no analog channel, no divider

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and no I²C bus are needed. Mount it inside the headspace.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no external parts, nothing to wire

svg.text: The UNO Q carries four on-board RGB LEDs.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two are driven by the Linux MPU, two by the STM32.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: This design uses the two MCU-side LEDs, so there are

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: no indicator LEDs, resistors or switching transistor

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Every rail is 3.3 V. The UNO Q headers are not 5 V like an UNO R3.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A 5 V divider or pull-up exceeds the 3.6 V absolute maximum on the analog and digital pins.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Status indication uses the two MCU-side on-board RGB LEDs (LED3 and LED4), so no GPIO is spent on it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One component total: the AM2320, on a DHT-compatible single-wire bus. A 4-pin I2C module works too

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with SENSOR_SINGLE_WIRE set to 0 in the sketch; a 3-pin module cannot do I2C at all.
